name: cachepin
description: Zero-dep Rust+SIMD LLM prompt-cache compiler, exact mixed-TTL DP solver, auditor & Shadow-KV router
long_description: Losslessly canonicalizes multi-agent LLM prompts (deterministic JSON keys, sorted tool schemas, bijective volatile timestamp/UUID hoisting, All-Gather shared-block alignment), solves exact O(M^2 K) mixed-TTL (1h/5m) breakpoints, audits Claude Code & Codex session traces, and simulates 8-GPU Shadow-KV routing.

tools.name: optimize_prompt
tools.description: Losslessly canonicalize an Anthropic/OpenAI request payload and compute exact O(M^2 K) mixed-TTL cache breakpoints.

tools.name: diagnose_diff
tools.description: SIMD byte-level prefix divergence forensics between two prompts with root-cause classification and USD waste.

tools.name: plan_breakpoints
tools.description: Solve exact constrained mixed-TTL (1h before 5m, K <= 4) breakpoints and 270s keepalive break-even.

tools.name: audit_trace
tools.description: Audit a JSONL request trace or Claude Code / Codex transcript directory for cache misses and counterfactual USD savings.

tools.name: route_simulate
tools.description: Simulate multi-GPU Shadow-KV adaptive-replication routing against Round-Robin, Least-Loaded, Consistent-Hash, and SingleHome-2xDivert.
